summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the consummation of Cartesian Growth Corp IV's initial public offering (IPO) of 27,500,000 units at $10.00 per unit for gross proceeds of $275,000,000, including partial exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option. The registrant, a blank-check company, entered into standard IPO agreements (underwriting, warrant, letter agreements). No acquisition target, merger, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special situation is announced. This is a routine SPAC IPO consummation event, not an actionable special-situation filing.
